agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Scale and breadth of technological significance

analytical_question: How significant is deployed generative AI, and how should its broader potential inform this retail reporting proposal?
general_et_finding: Potential Promethean, provisionally, following the course calibration (S0). The usable system combines models, inference services, interfaces and human verification. It lowers the barrier to producing cognitive outputs without specialist production skills. Broad language capabilities (S1), workplace benefits (S2) and uptake (S4) support this possibility. Suppression would remove new AI-assisted workflows, although the evidence does not show economy-wide collapse. Tenfold gains and irreversible dependence are not established.
application_finding: The proposed internal reporting use is incremental workflow improvement, not independently civilization-changing. Existing reports and human analysts remain substitutes.
organization_specific_finding: For this moderate fast-follower retailer, broad potential justifies attention but cannot establish local value. The available reviewer and verified tables make a bounded evaluation conceivable; no measured benefits exist.

evidence.claim: System gate, categorical-barrier and suppression tests, multiple human-life tiers, six criteria, prospective ceiling.
evidence.notes: The chapter calibrates generative AI as Potential Promethean; that interpretive judgment is not independent empirical proof. Chapter is not redistributed.

evidence.claim: Broad few-shot language capabilities and remaining task weaknesses.
evidence.notes: Not evidence of current reliability, economy-wide dependence, or a tenfold business improvement.

evidence.claim: Study of 5,172 customer-support agents reports 15% average productivity improvement, with heterogeneous effects.
evidence.notes: Single-firm assisted work; does not prove tenfold gains, elimination of expertise, or aggregate employment effects.

evidence.claim: AI helps some consulting tasks and reduces correctness on a tested outside-frontier task.
evidence.notes: Task-specific evidence from an earlier model, not a universal present-day failure rate.

evidence.claim: Late-2024 surveys show broad uptake, with workday use lower than any recent use.
evidence.notes: Dated U.S. self-reports, not an October 2026 global estimate, causal welfare evidence or infrastructure dependence.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: S3 shows that apparent fluency can coexist with reduced correctness on some tasks.
S2 reports a 15% average improvement, not a tenfold improvement.
Uptake does not prove irreversibility; manual reporting remains possible.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in breakthrough capability; low confidence in long-run Promethean realization. No present-day civilization-wide dependence is demonstrated.
value_opportunity_implication: Possible reduction in drafting effort, conditional on review-inclusive time and accuracy measurements.
risk_governance_implication: Human verification remains necessary. Do not use the label to bypass review or assign calculations to the language model.
recommendation_management_implication: Consider a reversible internal comparison with the existing reporting workflow. Adoption authority remains with management and the other specialists.
change_monitoring_triggers: Quality-adjusted total costs and accuracy from a local comparison
Evidence that users can reliably verify outputs
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold Confirmed Promethean and deployment approval.
Request local task quality, review effort and cost evidence.
